title: snippet.rs: SearchSnippet/get with capability gating
description:
Implement SearchSnippet/get in src/snippet.rs.

## Method to implement

### SearchSnippet/get (RFC 8621 §5.9)
- Input: accountId, filter (same FilterCondition as Email/query), emailIds
- Output: list of SearchSnippet objects — one per requested emailId
  - id: emailId
  - subject: highlighted snippet of subject, or null
  - preview: highlighted snippet of body, or null
- Highlight format: mark matched terms with a tag (RFC leaves format to implementation; use <mark>term</mark>)

## Capability gating
- If the backend does NOT support SearchSnippet (backend.supports_type::<SearchSnippet>() returns false):
  → return accountNotSupportedByMethod error invocation (not a panic, not a 400)
- MemoryBackend: supports SearchSnippet (simple substring search)

## Source references
- Stalwart (AGPL — read, do not copy): search snippet handling in ~/GIT/stalwart-jmap-server/main/crates/jmap/src/email/
- RFC 8621 §5.9
- supports_type pattern: check jmap-chat-server for capability gating example

## Test vectors
- SearchSnippet/get with filter={text: 'hello'} on email containing 'hello world' → preview contains '<mark>hello</mark>'
- Backend with supports_type=false → accountNotSupportedByMethod error
